test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Answer the following question on the basis of the bar graph given.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ac5d934752313297407716bd743db8fcc4bcecbdafa3422ae136774cf99876a.png] 

Which year shows the highest change in the revenue obtained from magazines?
solution:
**Given:**

Revenue from magazines in lakhs:

1989: 31

1990: 39

1991: 45

1992: 50

**Formula used:**

Change in revenue = Revenue of current year - Revenue of previous year

**Calculation:**

Change from 1989 to 1990 = 39 - 31 = 8

Change from 1990 to 1991 = 45 - 39 = 6

Change from 1991 to 1992 = 50 - 45 = 5

**∴ The year 1990 shows the highest change in the revenue obtained from magazines, with an increase of 8 lakhs.**
